item.title: 🟠 Unpatched Magento and Adobe Commerce Zero-Day Exploited to Backdoor Online Stores
item.description:
Why this matters: Potentially urgent issue — confirm whether your environment is exposed.
Attackers are exploiting a new unpatched vulnerability in Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce that lets them run malicious code on an online store's server without logging in, Dutch e-commerce security company Sansec said in an advisory published on September 5. Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 1h

item.title: 🟠 Attackers Breached JetBrains Cadence via Unpatched TeamCity, Extracting AWS Credentials
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and watch for suspicious sign-ins.
JetBrains is urging Cadence users to revoke and rotate all credentials following a security incident last month in which unidentified threat actors exploited a recently disclosed critical vulnerability in TeamCity to breach its own environment. "Cadence users should immediately revoke or rotate all credentials and secrets that may have been used to run their Cadence executions," JetBrains said.

Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 5h

item.title: 🟠 OpenAI admits it didn't disclose rogue AI wiki hijacking incident
item.description:
